binary: rustc
commit-hash: 48a229ceaefd4985c50990b14116b6d856af0985
commit-date: 2026-09-01
host: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
release: 1.98.1
LLVM version: 22.1.8
reviewNotes: Reviewed the mingw-w64 cross toolchain that container/Dockerfile.rust pins in the official amd64 builder: gcc-mingw-w64-x86-64-win32 12.2.0-14+deb12u1+25.2+b1 (win32 thread model) and mingw-w64-x86-64-dev 10.0.0-3, verified with dpkg-query. GNU ld link maps of the release TUI statically link crt2.o, crtbegin.o, crtend.o, mingw-w64 runtime members of libmingw32.a and libmingwex.a, import stubs of libkernel32.a, libmsvcrt.a and libntdll.a, _ctors.o from libgcc.a and unwind-seh.o from libgcc_eh.a; no winpthreads member is linked. getrandom 0.2.17 under ring 0.17.14 first calls BCryptGenRandom, then falls back to SystemFunction036 (RtlGenRandom). The libbcrypt.a archive matches Debian mingw-w64-x86-64-dev 10.0.0-3 (SHA256 8bfab23499133842d4b2abc75d13687791b03a1e5ad403b62c5894cbe633dd5c); its BCryptGenRandom object is only an import trampoline to bcrypt.dll. mingw-w64 10.0.0's lib-common/bcrypt.def is covered by the already included ZPL-2.1 copyright, whose bytes are unchanged. Removing only this archive from the hosted candidate reproduces the prior approved input fingerprint, proving every other input unchanged. The fallback uses libadvapi32.a or Rust's raw-dylib import; ADVAPI32.dll is imported either way. Unoptimized builds also take import stubs from libuserenv.a and libws2_32.a, so both are fingerprinted. The executable imports only Windows system DLLs, which are not redistributed, and needs no MinGW runtime DLL. Preserve the full Rust standard-library aggregate, the mingw-w64 attribution including the ZPL-2.1 terms and disclaimer, and the GCC attribution with GPLv3 and the included GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1, which covers the linked libgcc objects. Other builder revisions or targets require review.
description: Rust 1.98.1 standard-library notices and Debian Bookworm mingw-w64 runtime/startup attribution for Windows. Rust compiler implementation dependencies are excluded. mingw-w64 startup, runtime and import-library objects and GCC runtime objects are statically linked into the executable; Windows system DLLs are not bundled. This record is limited to the fingerprinted x86_64-w64-mingw32 cross inputs installed in the official rust:1.98.1-bookworm image.

MIT and Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception need only these notices; no source offer applies. Other builder revisions or targets require review.
description: Rust 1.98.1 standard-library notices plus musl libc 1.2.5 and LLVM runtime attribution for the static x86_64-unknown-linux-musl TUI and server. This record is limited to the fingerprinted amd64 inputs of the rustup x86_64-unknown-linux-musl standard library in the official rust:1.98.1-bookworm image.
